subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We ______ the mathematical issue with zest and vigour.
solution:
The correct answer is "Option 2: **solved".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When dealing with mathematical issues or problems, the appropriate verb to use is **"solved".**
 
• **It implies** that the issue was dealt with successfully, which suits the context of the sentence that the problem was tackled with **"zest and vigour".**
 
• The rest of the options slightly alter the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is "Option 2: **solved".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **"Cleared up" **and** "settled"** can also be used to denote resolving an issue but their usage tends to be more common in reference to disagreements, conflicts, or misunderstandings rather than mathematical problems.
 
• **"Remedied" **could be used in medical or general problem-solving scenario.
